record.question:
State whether the following statements are true or false.
(a) Ammunition includes grenades.
(b) Acquisition of arms includes accepting as a gift.
(c) Previous sanction of the District Magistrate is necessary, before prosecuting any person in respect of any of the offence under Section 3 of the Arms Act, 1959.
(d) Firearms includes artillery and hand grenades.
(e) Transfer of arms license is an inheritable property.
record.explanation: The statements evaluate as (a) true, (b) true, (c) true, (d) true, and (e) false under the Arms Act, 1959: ammunition includes grenades; acquisition includes taking possession by purchase, exchange or otherwise (thus as a gift); Section 39 requires prior District Magistrate sanction for prosecution of a Section 3 offence; firearms includes artillery and hand grenades; and an arms licence is not inheritable property. However, all four supplied options are identical placeholders ('Not applicable - True/False format'), so there is no defensible option index for this multi-part true/false response.
